This is not a coordination role; you get real spend, a team to build, and the authority to decide what to try next, with weekly updates on experiment outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Growth Plan & Execution: Own the growth plan, set quarterly targets across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and retention, sequence work, and ship it.

  • Onboarding: Optimize the path from install to a live consent banner, reduce drop‑off, and deliver first value quickly.
  • Engagement: Build lifecycle programs via email, in‑app messaging, and in‑product prompts to deepen usage.
  • Retention & Churn: Track cohort retention, diagnose churn, run win‑back/reactivation, and implement structural fixes.
